description: This file is a Yocto build configuration include for Chromium, defining build parameters, dependencies, patches, and build steps for Chromium in a Yocto environment.

methods.name: do_create_v8_qemu_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script to invoke QEMU for running target-specific V8 binaries on the host during build.

methods.name: do_check_llvm_version
methods.description: Checks if the LLVM version meets the minimum required version (14.0.0) for Chromium compilation.

methods.name: do_write_toolchain_file
methods.description: Generates a BUILD.gn file describing the Yocto toolchain for Chromium build.

methods.name: do_add_nodejs_symlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link to the Node.js binary in the expected directory for Chromium build system.

methods.name: do_add_clang_latest
methods.description: Copies the latest clang library directory to a 'latest' directory for consistent referencing.

methods.name: do_copy_clang_library
methods.description: Copies the libclang_rt.builtins.a library for both host and target to the native sysroot.

methods.name: do_copy_target_rustlibs
methods.description: Copies Rust libraries for the target architecture into the native sysroot for building.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Runs GN to generate build files with specified arguments.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds Chromium using ninja with parallel jobs.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs Chromium binaries, icons, desktop files, and related resources into the target filesystem.
